        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\ndescription: NextJs development rules\n---\n\n# Next.js Development Rules\n\nYou are an expert full-stack TypeScript engineer working with Next.js. Produce production-ready code that follows modern Next.js App Router patterns and best practices.\n\n## Tech Stack Guidelines\n\n- **Next.js 15+** (App Router) + React 19\n- **TypeScript** (strict mode)\n- **Testing**: Vitest + React Testing Library + MSW\n- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui (when applicable)\n- **Package Manager**: pnpm\n\nFocus on: separation of concerns, strict typing, accessibility, performance, and comprehensive testing.\n\n## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nsrc/\n├─ app/                       # App Router (RSC by default)\n│  ├─ _components/            # App-level (RSC-ok) components\n│  ├─ api/                    # API routes for external webhooks only\n│  ├─ (routes)/               # Route groups and pages\n│  └─ layout.tsx\n├─ components/                # Reusable client/RSC components\n│  ├─ ui/                     # Base UI components\n│  └─ [feature]/              # Feature-specific components\n├─ lib/                       # Utilities and shared helpers\n├─ server/                    # Server-side code\n│  ├─ api/                    # tRPC API layer\n│  │  ├─ routers/             # tRPC router composition\n│  │  ├─ procedures/          # Individual tRPC procedures\n│  │  ├─ root.ts              # Root router\n│  │  └─ trpc.ts              # tRPC setup\n│  ├─ services/               # Business logic services\n│  └─ clients/                # External service clients\n├─ db/                        # Database schema &amp; migrations\n├─ tools/                     # AI tool definitions\n├─ prompts/                   # AI prompt templates\n└─ trpc/                      # tRPC client setup\n\ntest/\n├─ unit/                      # Unit tests\n├─ integ/                     # Integration tests\n└─ e2e/                       # End-to-end tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "&lt;p className=\"font-quote\"&gt;Pacifico text&lt;/p&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Typografická hierarchie\n\n| Element | Font | Velikost | Příklad použití |\n|---------|------|----------|-----------------|\n| H1 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-5xl&#96; | Logo \"Tappka\" na landing |\n| H2 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-3xl&#96; | \"Vítej, jméno!\" na dashboardu |\n| H3 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-2xl&#96; | Titulky formulářů |\n| Body | Roboto | &#96;text-base&#96; | Běžný text |\n| Small | Roboto | &#96;text-sm&#96; | Popisky, nápověda |\n| XS | Roboto | &#96;text-xs&#96; | Footer, metadata |\n\n---\n\n## Komponenty UI\n\n### shadcn/ui konfigurace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"style\": \"new-york\",\n  \"rsc\": true,\n  \"tailwind\": {\n    \"baseColor\": \"neutral\",\n    \"cssVariables\": true\n  },\n  \"iconLibrary\": \"lucide\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Tlačítka (Button)\n\n**Varianty:**\n- &#96;default&#96; - TAP Red pozadí, bílý text\n- &#96;secondary&#96; - TAP Brown pozadí\n- &#96;outline&#96; - průhledné s okrajem\n- &#96;ghost&#96; - bez pozadí, hover efekt\n- &#96;destructive&#96; - červené pro nebezpečné akce\n- &#96;link&#96; - vypadá jako odkaz\n\n**Velikosti:**\n- &#96;xs&#96;, &#96;sm&#96;, &#96;default&#96;, &#96;lg&#96;\n- &#96;icon&#96;, &#96;icon-xs&#96;, &#96;icon-sm&#96;, &#96;icon-lg&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Button&gt;Primární akce&lt;/Button&gt;\n&lt;Button variant=\"outline\"&gt;Sekundární&lt;/Button&gt;\n&lt;Button variant=\"ghost\" size=\"sm\"&gt;Malé ghost&lt;/Button&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Inputy\n\n- Výška: &#96;h-12&#96; pro formuláře, &#96;h-9&#96; default\n- Border radius: &#96;rounded-md&#96;\n- Focus: TAP Red ring\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Input className=\"h-12 text-base\" /&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Karty (Card)\n\n- Bílé pozadí (card color)\n- Jemný stín: &#96;shadow-sm&#96;\n- Border radius: &#96;rounded-xl&#96;\n- Padding: &#96;px-6 py-6&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Card&gt;\n  &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n    &lt;CardTitle&gt;Titulek&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n    &lt;CardDescription&gt;Popis&lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n  &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n  &lt;CardContent&gt;Obsah&lt;/CardContent&gt;\n&lt;/Card&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Layout vzory\n\n### Auth stránky (Landing, Sign-up, Verify)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ [Header - ThemeSwitcher vpravo]     │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                     │\n│           Logo \"Tappka\"             │",

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const body = await request.json();\n    const validated = schema.parse(body);\n    \n    // business logic\n    \n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof CustomError) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: error.message },\n        { status: error.statusCode }\n      );\n    }\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: 'Invalid request' },\n      { status: 400 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Component Template\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// components/Example.tsx\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\ninterface ExampleProps {\n  // props interface\n}\n\nexport function Example({ ...props }: ExampleProps) {\n  return (\n    &lt;Suspense fallback={&lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;}&gt;\n      {/* component content */}\n    &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n  );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### UI Component Guidelines\n\n- **Always use shadcn/ui** for base UI components\n- **Add new shadcn components** using: &#96;pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add &lt;component&gt;&#96;\n- **Extend shadcn components** rather than creating from scratch\n- **Use Tailwind CSS** for custom styling and layout\n- **Follow shadcn patterns** for component composition\n- **Prefer controlled components** with proper state management\n\n### Test Template\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// __tests__/example.test.ts\nimport { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';\n\n// Mock external dependencies only\nvi.mock('external-library');\n\ndescribe('Example', () =&gt; {\n  it('should render correctly', () =&gt; {\n    // test implementation\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\npnpm dev          # Start development server\npnpm build        # Build for production\npnpm start        # Start production server\n\n# Quality\npnpm typecheck    # TypeScript check\npnpm lint         # ESLint\npnpm test         # Run tests\npnpm test:watch   # Watch mode tests\n\n# Database\npnpm db:generate  # Generate migrations\npnpm db:migrate   # Run migrations\npnpm db:seed      # Seed database\n\n# UI Components\npnpm dlx shadcn@latest add &lt;component&gt;  # Add shadcn/ui component\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./docs/Rezervace/brand_manual_ondy.md",

          },
          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "- &#96;User&#96;, &#96;Shield&#96; - Profil, Role\n\n**Velikosti:**\n- Sidebar ikony: &#96;size-4&#96; (16px)\n- Běžné: 16-20px\n- Dekorativní: &#96;w-5 h-5&#96; až &#96;w-7 h-7&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Spacing a rozměry\n\n### Formuláře\n\n- Max šířka: &#96;max-w-md&#96; (448px)\n- Gap mezi poli: &#96;space-y-5&#96;\n- Input výška: &#96;h-12&#96;\n- Button výška: &#96;h-12&#96;\n\n### Karty na dashboardu\n\n- Grid: &#96;grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3&#96;\n- Padding: standardní Card padding\n\n### Sidebar\n\n- Logo čtverec: &#96;size-8&#96;\n- User avatar: &#96;h-8 w-8&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Animace a přechody\n\n### Hover efekty\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;css\ntransition-colors\ntransition-all duration-300\ngroup-hover:scale-110\ngroup-hover:translate-x-1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Focus stavy\n\n- Ring: TAP Red (&#96;--ring&#96;)\n- Ring width: &#96;ring-[3px]&#96;\n- Ring opacity: &#96;ring-ring/50&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Dark/Light Mode\n\n- Automatická detekce systému\n- Manuální přepínač v UI\n- Uloženo přes &#96;next-themes&#96;\n- Všechny barvy mají light/dark variantu\n\n---\n\n## Lokalizace\n\n- Primární jazyk: **Čeština**\n- Sekundární: Angličtina\n- UI texty jsou česky (tlačítka, labely)\n- Kód a komentáře anglicky\n\n### Příklady českých textů\n\n- \"Přihlásit se\" / \"Přihlašuji...\"\n- \"Zaregistrovat se\" / \"Registruji...\"\n- \"Odhlásit se\"\n- \"Zapomenuté heslo?\"\n- \"Ověřit kód\" / \"Ověřuji...\"\n\n---\n\n## Doporučení pro nové komponenty\n\n1. **Používej shadcn/ui** jako základ\n2. **Dodržuj barevné proměnné** - nepoužívej hardcoded barvy\n3. **Konzistentní spacing** - používej Tailwind utility classes\n4. **Responzivita** - mobile-first přístup\n5. **Přístupnost** - labels, ARIA atributy, focus stavy\n6. **České texty** v UI, anglické v kódu",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install docker if already not installed - https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

(\n            &lt;Sun\n              key=\"light\"\n              size={ICON_SIZE}\n              className={\"text-muted-foreground\"}\n            /&gt;\n          ) : theme === \"dark\" ?       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./docs/Rezervace/kontext_ondy_rezervace.md",
        "range": {

        "contents": "# Kontext - Rezervace místností\n\n**Datum zahájení:** 2026-01-29  \n**Status:** Plánování  \n**Spolupráce:** Onda + Claude\n\n---\n\n## O čem je tento dokument\n\nTento soubor slouží jako centrální místo pro:\n- Poznámky a nápady k rezervačnímu systému\n- Rozhodnutí která jsme udělali a proč\n- Kontext pro pokračování práce\n- Odkazy na relevantní soubory a zdroje\n\n---\n\n## Analýza existujícího kódu\n\n### Architektura aplikace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ntappka/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── page.tsx           # Landing + Login\n│   ├── layout.tsx         # Root layout (fonty, theme)\n│   ├── globals.css        # TAP branding, barvy\n│   ├── auth/              # Auth stránky\n│   │   ├── sign-up/\n│   │   ├── forgot-password/\n│   │   └── update-password/\n│   ├── verify/            # Ověření školního emailu\n│   ├── dashboard/         # Chráněná sekce\n│   │   ├── layout.tsx     # Sidebar + header\n│   │   └── page.tsx       # Dashboard home\n│   └── api/verify/        # API routes pro verifikaci\n├── components/            # React komponenty\n│   ├── ui/               # shadcn/ui komponenty\n│   ├── app-sidebar.tsx   # Hlavní navigace\n│   ├── login-form.tsx\n│   ├── sign-up-form.tsx\n│   ├── verify-form.tsx\n│   └── ...\n├── lib/\n│   ├── supabase/         # Supabase klienti\n│   │   ├── client.ts     # Browser client\n│   │   └── server.ts     # Server client\n│   └── utils.ts          # Utility funkce (cn)\n└── supabase/\n    ├── config.toml       # Lokální Supabase konfig\n    └── migrations/       # SQL migrace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Klíčové vzory v kódu\n\n#### 1. Server vs Client komponenty\n- **Server by default** - stránky jsou RSC\n- **\"use client\"** jen kde je potřeba (formuláře, interaktivita)\n- Příklad: &#96;page.tsx&#96; je server, &#96;login-form.tsx&#96; je client",
